title: Low Tier God
description: This mod adds Low Tier God into the game as a small boss you can fight.
body:
This mod adds **Low Tier God** as a small boss. He lives in a house that you will have to find to fight him. He will use his ability to **strike down lightnings and just melee you**. You are able to find or craft a **Stream Camera** to spawn npcs that throw stuff at him. When dead, he will drop an item called **Lightning Port** that you can use to strike down lightnings yourself. 

When chasing you, he will say things to annoy you and just get angry at you overall. **!! If you are offended by what he says, I suggest you don't play this mod. !!** Things he say **are not meant to be taken seriously** and **aren't even that bad.**

This mod is **my first ever mod** and I do not expect it to be very good. I will hopefully improve myself and make better mods in the future.
